2023-24.title: Code Vengers
2023-24.description: Code-vengers is an 8-hour coding marathon where participants, typically in teams, are tasked with developing innovative solutions to real-world problems. Teams are given a theme or specific challenges at the start of the event, and they must brainstorm, design, and implement a functional prototype within the given time frame. The hackathon encourages participants to think critically and utilize their coding skills to create impactful and practical solutions. Judges evaluate the projects based on criteria like originality, feasibility, and technical complexity.
details: Code-vengers is an 8-hour hackathon focused on solving real-world problems.
Teams collaborate to brainstorm, design, and implement a functional prototype.
The event emphasizes creativity, collaboration, and technical expertise.
Projects are judged on originality, feasibility, and technical complexity.

2023-24.title: Robo Race
2023-24.description: Robo-race is an exhilarating competition where teams design, build, and race their custom-built line-following robots. Participants use their knowledge of robotics, electronics, and programming to create robots capable of navigating a predefined track marked with lines. The robots must follow the track as quickly and accurately as possible, avoiding obstacles and handling various track configurations. The event tests the participants' engineering skills, including design optimization and algorithm development, as well as their ability to work under pressure.
details: We created a challenging track with various obstacles and turns.
Teams enthusiastically designed and programmed their robots.
We conducted practice runs to help teams fine-tune their robots.
The final races were filled with excitement, enthusiastic participation, and cheering.

2023-24.title: Code Decode
2023-24.description: Code-decode is a rigorous coding competition that challenges participants to demonstrate their programming skills and problem-solving abilities. Competitors are presented with a series of coding problems of varying difficulty levels, which they must solve within a specified time limit. The problems cover a range of topics, including algorithms, data structures, and logical puzzles. Participants can use their preferred programming languages to write and submit their solutions.
details: Code-Decode is a coding competition where participants solve problems within a time limit.
The event covers algorithms, data structures, and logical puzzles.
Participants can use their preferred programming languages for solutions.
Winners are chosen based on the accuracy and efficiency of their solutions.

2023-24.title: Quiz Blast
2023-24.description: Quiz-blast is an engaging tech-themed quiz competition designed to test participants' knowledge of technology, current trends, and general tech trivia. The quiz covers a wide array of topics, including software, hardware, programming languages, tech history, and recent advancements in the tech industry. Participants can compete individually or in teams, answering multiple-choice questions, true/false statements, and open-ended questions. The event is structured in rounds, with each round increasing in difficulty.
details: Quiz-blast tests participants' tech knowledge across software, hardware, and current trends.
The competition includes multiple-choice, true/false, and open-ended questions.
Participants can compete individually or in teams in a round-based format.
The quiz gets progressively harder, fostering a competitive and fun atmosphere.

2023-24.title: E-Waste
2023-24.description: The E-Waste Art Expo is a unique exhibition that showcases creative art pieces made from electronic waste, promoting sustainability and environmental awareness. Participants are encouraged to use discarded electronic components, such as circuit boards, wires, and old gadgets, to create artistic and functional pieces. The expo aims to highlight the importance of recycling and reusing electronic waste, demonstrating how innovation and creativity can transform waste into valuable art.
details: The E-Waste Art Expo showcases creative art made from discarded electronic components.
The event promotes sustainability by encouraging the reuse and recycling of e-waste.
Participants create artistic and functional pieces using circuit boards, wires, and old gadgets.
Exhibits are judged on creativity, originality, and effective use of e-waste materials.
